English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us #false AI-Generated Video of Massive Floods in Indonesia Goes Viral on X False A viral video on X claiming to show a massive Indonesian mountain flood is AI-generated misinformation, despite Grok’s false verification. by Anonymous | February 13, 2026 Indonesia is currently facing multiple challenges due to heavy rainfall and volcanic activity. Amidst this situation, a video claiming to show a massive flood cascading from a mountaintop in Indonesia has been widely shared on the X platform. The video has garnered significant views and shares. Notably, ‘Grok’, the Artificial Intelligence (AI) tool integrated into the X platform for data verification, also provided a response suggesting the video was authentic. However, FactSeeker investigated the footage and confirmed that it is an AI-generated video. Furthermore, upon verifying the data provided by ‘Grok,’ it was found that there is no evidence of such a specific disaster in any official government announcements or credible news reports from Indonesia. Therefore, it is confirmed that the information provided by the ‘Grok’ AI tool to X users was inaccurate. Conclusion FactSeeker confirms that the video circulating on social media, which purports to show a massive flood descending from a mountain in Indonesia, was created using AI technology and is not real.
